about_the_game:
Your job? Break into cursed houses, steal the goods, and make it back alive.

You’re tasked with meeting a quota by collecting cursed objects.

Each one you touch changes the run. Some curse you, others change your vehicle or even the road back.

The drive back is procedurally generated, packed with chaos, and never the same twice.

But you’re not alone out there… monsters roam the fog, waiting to make sure you never hit your quota.

No two runs play out the same, each one’s unique with different houses, monsters, objects, comedy moments, and your own bad driving.

Features

Funny horror gameplay - Cursed items create unpredictable scares and some hilarious moments.

Randomized haunted runs - New layouts, new curses, new chaos every time.

Vehicle upgrades - Earn and lose them with every quota run.

Permanent cosmetics - Customize your character with rewards that never reset.

VOIP - Talk in game to communicate with your friends for best experience.

Steal the cursed loot. Meet the quota. Survive the drive.

short_description: An online co-op horror game with up to 4 players. Break into abandoned houses, steal cursed junk, survive the drive. Every item you grab changes the run, cursing you, your ride, or twisting the road back. The route’s never the same.
